Memory Abstraction Interface (MemIf)

Abstracts underlying Flash and EEPROM memory drivers.
function MemIf_SetMode [SWS_MemIf_00038]
void Mem If_SetMode(Mem If_ModeTypeMode);
Invokes the "Set Mode" functions of all underlying memory abstraction modules.
function MemIf_Read [SWS_MemIf_00039]
Std_ReturnType Mem If_Read(uint8 Device Index, uint16 Block Number, uint16 Block Offset, uint8* Data BufferPtr, uint16 Length);
Invokes the "Read" function of the underlying memory abstraction module selected by the parameter Device Index.
function MemIf_Write [SWS_MemIf_00040]
Std_ReturnType Mem If_Write(uint8 Device Index, uint16 Block Number, const uint8* Data BufferPtr);
Invokes the "Write" function of the underlying memory abstraction module selected by the parameter Device Index.
